json_ld.description:
Bring the taste of fall into your snack routine with the Perfect Bar Pumpkin Pie, a limited-edition seasonal flavor that combines indulgence with nutrition. Each refrigerated protein bar delivers 14g of protein from peanut butter and whole food ingredients, along with a blend of 20+ organic superfoods like dried pumpkin, carrot, spinach, and kale.
Crafted to be both delicious and nourishing, this bar captures the classic taste of pumpkin pie with warm seasonal spices—without the artificial additives. Perfect Bar Pumpkin Pie is USDA Organic, Non-GMO Project Verified, and gluten-free, making it a better-for-you option for those who want flavor and function in every bite.
Whether you enjoy it as a midday snack, post-workout fuel, or a festive seasonal treat, this protein bar satisfies cravings while supporting balanced nutrition. Stock up while it lasts—the Perfect Bar Pumpkin Pie is a limited seasonal release and a fall favorite among fans who crave wholesome indulgence.
